reuse.why: Extends the existing shared getMonthWideTargetCategories selection instead of adding a second query or per-action filtering.

duplication.why: The hidden rule is changed once in the shared SQL; each action only forwards the flag.

placement.why: The flag is applied in the category-selection helper in budget/actions.ts, where the tree decides which categories month-wide actions touch.

scope.why: Touches only the selection helper, the six month-wide action signatures (via a shared MonthWideActionArgs type) and a test.

maintainability.why: Clean single point of change with a named args type; the updated comment wrongly reads as if every exclusion is lifted by the flag, and the `? = 1 OR` SQL trick is slightly opaque.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions keep calling getMonthWideTargetCategories.
